To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the problem of gender-based violence, specifically the problem of rape, is a problem of moral consciousness and that the solution to the problem of rape is to reawaken an individual moral consciousness.

(a) The majority of South African men believe that rape is a crime that should be punished, (b) The majority of men believe that rape should be prevented by changing the attitudes of rapists and by punishing them, and (c) A minority of men believe that women can take steps to avoid rape, that men are biologically predisposed to rape, or that women are to blame for being raped.
the majority of women in our sample reported experiencing at least one incident of sexual violence during their lifetimes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of rape, which is one of the strands of gender based violence.
the question of how we can understand the problem of gender-based violence in South Africa, particularly rape, in the context of our current social reality and what can be done to address it.
the problem of rape, as a strand of Gender Based Violence (GBV).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
rape is not only a social problem but also a moral one.
, rape in South Africa is a problem of moral consciousness and that it is not only caused by social and psychological factors, but also by a moral failing of the rapists and their victims.
the problem of rape and other forms of gender based violence is a problem of moral consciousness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

rape in South Africa is an act of violence which is not only perpetrated by the perpetrators but also by the victims who do not report the cases to the police and by the community who do not condemn the acts.
we have shown the importance of a moral consciousness in addressing the problem of gender-based violence.
the paper is a call for a new way of thinking about rape and gender based violence, which would involve a rethinking of the consciousness that encourages gender based violence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the problem of gender-based violence, specifically, rape, in South Africa is a moral problem.
rape in South Africa is a problem that should be addressed through the reawakening of the moral consciousness of individuals.
